clue.text: Cancelled case for internship in a day

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, here placed within the name of a day

parts.note: Wed is the short form of Wednesday

indicators.note: a case is the outside of something, so only the outer pair of letters of the next word is kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of internship

explanation.surface: An intern's placement has been called off at short notice.
explanation.walkthrough: The outer letters of internship go inside WED to give W-IP-ED.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe a debt or record is to erase it, so wiped is a synonym for cancelled.

clue.text: Those enduring conflicting losses caution against operating system, no names given

explanation.walkthrough: N is the abbreviation for name; both WARN and WINDOWS lose their N.
explanation.definitionFit: War widows are women whose husbands died in battle, so they bear losses caused by conflict.

clue.text: Choose to dispense with tool

explanation.definitionFit: A pickaxe is a digging tool with a pointed iron head on a long handle.

clue.text: Doctor's first dictation periodically lacking the same thing

explanation.definitionFit: Ditto is used to mean as before or the same again, standing in for a repeated item.

taken as written

clue.text: Wind event up, culture having left in even London landmark?

clue.text: Heather, not initially, scoffs too much cheese

clue.text: Bishop converted a very evil slimy creature

taken as written

clue.text: Mistake in quote picked up after several deliveries

clue.text: Usually beer served round most of Salisbury

clue.text: Interrupting all others, one's setter's impervious to external influences?
